messages:
Priya: Quick intake — bringing up orca-mini-13b with q4_mha. Initial quant run shows token shifts for long-context prompts, want to prioritize because customer benchmarks hit by this.
Kenji: Can you paste the repro? short test or a failing eval case is enough.
Ava: Repro steps below, ran on staging runtime-2.1. Output tokens misaligned after ~120 tokens.
Ava: ```
./scripts/run_infer.sh --model orca-mini-13b --quant q4_mha --seq_len 1024 --prompts tests/long_context.jsonl 
# Observed: generation diverges vs fp16 baseline at step 121, then repeats tokens
```
eval-bot: Quick regressions report: +15% ppl on long-context bench, BLEU-like drop ~2.3% on summary prompts, failure cases concentrated on >512 prefix.
Sam: My hunch is RoPE/rotary base mismatch between our kernel and the model config — that can shift attention phase and break kv alignment. Any chance model config has nonstandard "rotary_emb_base"?
Kenji: Confirmed — model config uses rotary_base=8192 while runtime default was 10000. Also found a kv index off-by-one in continuous-batching path. Small snippet from unit test: ```assert cached_kv.shape[2] == expected_seq_len``` failed when batch had mixed prefixes.
Priya: Proposed plan: 1) pin to fp16 to rule out quantization noise 2) add a small test that replays cached_kv offsets across batching permutations 3) bump rotary_base from config into kernel selection path 4) run a 4-bit sweep with eval harness and post results. I'll file an onboarding ticket and tag infra/runtime. Priority: high for this model.
infra-bot: Deployed branch fix/kv-rotary-align to staging (runtime-2.1-staging). Watch logs at https://staging.redwood/infer/logs/1760845123 : memory/latency unaffected.
Ava: I'll run the fp16 vs q4_mha comparison tonight and upload eval artifacts (diffs + sample failure prompts). Will also try re-quant with per-token scale fallback. :mag_right:
Kenji: If the rotary_base change fixes alignment we should add a compatibility check to model-onboard intake (fail if rotary_base != runtime-default and runtime cannot auto-adapt).
Priya: Agreed. I'll include that in the intake checklist and mark this thread as the canonical bring-up notes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
